description.value: A two-storey Super 8 by Wyndham property situated in Saanichton, just minutes from Victoria International Airport and a short ride from the Swartz Bay ferry terminal. It sits in a practical spot for cyclists arriving or departing the Southern Gulf Islands and Tsawwassen routes. As a national chain hotel it offers standardised, predictable lodging in an otherwise low-density suburban area.

address.value: 2477 Mount Newton Cross Road, Saanichton, BC
